body_markdown:
Nobody hands independent artists a manual. How do you book a tour, read a contract, make a great music video, or know when you’re ready for a manager? Many artists figure it out alone.


In September, Spotify launched


[Fresh Finds Forward](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2026-09-17/fresh-finds-forward/) , a program giving approximately 10,000 emerging independent artists each year resources, community, and support to answer those questions, turning early momentum into long-term growth. This week, we’re bringing hundreds from the program’s inaugural class together in Los Angeles for the first Fresh Finds Summit.


On November 4 and 5, Spotify will offer two days of masterclasses, live feedback, and honest conversations with artists, songwriters, and executives who were once where these emerging artists are now and went on to build successful careers.


“A Fresh Finds placement can be the moment an artist gets heard for the first time,” said


**Joe Hadley** , Spotify’s Global Head of Music Content and Partnerships. “The Summit brings Fresh Finds Forward to life in person, with two days of real, practical guidance from artists and industry leaders who’ve built lasting careers, shared with artists at a pivotal moment in their own.”


## **On the agenda** ****


Sessions will cover the parts of the business that matter most early in a career: songwriting, touring, money, building a team, making music videos, protecting your mental health, and how music curation works. Artists will also get live feedback on their own songs.


Speakers include


[John Legend](https://open.spotify.com/artist/5y2Xq6xcjJb2jVM54GHK3t) ,


[Ryan Tedder](https://open.spotify.com/artist/4we5S2VLjgY9KzIzApL1KI) ,


**María Zardoya** of


[The Marías](https://open.spotify.com/artist/2sSGPbdZJkaSE2AbcGOACx) and


[Not For Radio](https://open.spotify.com/artist/0oXhGlRUQ8aVTx8eO4MoMT) ,


[Quinn XCII](https://open.spotify.com/artist/3ApUX1o6oSz321MMECyIYd) ,


[JP Saxe](https://open.spotify.com/artist/66W9LaWS0DPdL7Sz8iYGYe) ,


[8AE](https://open.spotify.com/artist/1HX4A36aOWZMFx5eRHKIz1) , and


[Solly](https://open.spotify.com/artist/3HokwUmCzY9bqzFrnOIVWf) , alongside leaders from Backline, CAA, Good World, True Panther, and more, plus Spotify’s own editors. Some, like María Zardoya, were once


[Fresh Finds](https://open.spotify.com/genre/0JQ5DAqbMKFImHYGo3eTSg) artists themselves.


Fresh Finds Forward partners


[Splice](https://splice.com/) ,


[LANDR](https://www.landr.com/) , and


[BetterHelp](https://www.betterhelp.com/) will also be on-site to help artists make the most of the tools and resources available to them through the program. As a part of Spotify’s


[ongoing partnership](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2026-01-27/b-line-mental-health-hotline/) with


[Backline](https://backline.care/) to support artists in building sustainable careers, the Heart & Soul Wellness Lounge will give artists space to step away and meet with a nutritionist and a life coach. Attendees will also get access to the full suite of resources available via Backline, including B-LINE, the music industry’s 24/7 mental health and crisis support line.


And just as important is who else is in the room: artists attending will be joined by peers at the same stage, swapping notes and building a community they can lean on long after the event. Hundreds of Fresh Finds Forward artists will attend in person, and we’ll be filming sessions to share virtually with all of the thousands of artists in the program.


## **Why we’re gathering** ****


Fresh Finds has always been about spotting the artists who are next. For more than a decade, Spotify’s Fresh Finds playlists have helped over 80,000 artists across 127 countries break through. Fresh Finds Forward is designed to provide support after they’re discovered.


Since the program launched in September, it’s been a busy few months. Fresh Finds Forward hosted its first global livestream AMA, where


[Isaiah Rashad](https://open.spotify.com/artist/6aaMZ3fcfLv4tEbmY7bjRM) answered questions directly from program artists. Spotify also recently launched the first five episodes of the


[Found on Fresh Finds](https://open.spotify.com/show/78M4AqVTv6n4N2PnNiyZDR) series, which helps rising artists produce live performance videos. And Fresh Finds has taken discovery offline this year, with stages at Sounds That Move in Brooklyn,


[CMA Fest](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2026-06-12/cma-fest-spotify-house-highlights-photos/) , FORM Arcosanti, and Fresh Finds Live in Houston, along with Fresh Finds & Friends community mixers that brought together more than 350 emerging artists across Australia, and Fresh Finds on Campus events across Sub-Saharan Africa.


## **What’s next**


Follow


[@spotifyforartists](https://www.instagram.com/spotifyforartists/?hl=en) on Instagram for highlights from the Summit and updates from Fresh Finds Forward throughout the year. Fresh Finds Forward artists can also find livestreams, benefits, and more on the


[program site](https://artists.spotify.com/home) .
